:::{#cor-measure-finitely-additive}
#### Measures are finitely additive

Every [measure](#def-measure) is [finitely additive](#def-finite-additivity).

:::

::: proof

A measure $\measure$ is countably additive and has $\measure(\emptyset) = 0$ (@def-measure),
so @thm-countable-implies-finite applies to it.

:::
